description: This file implements the StorageManager functionality for a plugin in the WPEFramework, including methods for configuring storage paths, creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage for applications, and managing internal state and external dependencies.

classes.name: StorageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements storage management functions such as create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage for applications within the plugin framework.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the storage manager with the provided service, setting storage paths and initializing internal state.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified app ID and size, returning the storage path.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage information and location for a given app ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a given app ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specific app ID.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all storage data except for exempted app IDs.
